versions.subject: feat: add share access rule
versions.detection:
selection_eid:
    EventID: 5140
selection_share_name:
    ShareName|contains: '\\\\MSHTML_C7\\\\'
    ShareName|re: '[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}'
selection_share_path:
    ShareLocalPath|contains: '\\\\MSHTML_C7\\\\'
    ShareLocalPath|re: '[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}'
condition: selection_eid and 1 of selection_share_*
versions.spl: | rex field=ShareName "(?<ShareNameMatch>[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3})" | eval ShareNameCondition=if(isnotnull(ShareNameMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=ShareLocalPath "(?<ShareLocalPathMatch>[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3})" | eval ShareLocalPathCondition=if(isnotnull(ShareLocalPathMatch), "true", "false") | search EventID=5140 (ShareName="*\\\\MSHTML_C7\\\\*" ShareNameCondition="true") OR (ShareLocalPath="*\\\\MSHTML_C7\\\\*" ShareLocalPathCondition="true")
